answer: To resist Sybil attacks, networks deploy topological cut verifications alongside game-theoretic multi-agent auditing. An identity undertaking a transaction voyage must cross a bottleneck jetty formed by independent auditor clusters, each staking capital. Colluding Sybils must stake across every independent cut; fraudulent validations trigger stake slashing, driving attacker cost to scale with superlinear attacker cost. Each audit cluster applies an identity pigment to trace flow authenticity.
